mapper.select: SELECT -- 使用子查询分别从 drives 表和 charges 表获取数据 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drives WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND start_date >= #{startDate} AND start_date < #{endDate}) AS drive_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) FROM drives WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND start_date >= #{startDate} AND start_date < #{endDate}) AS total_distance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_min), 0) FROM drives WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND start_date >= #{startDate} AND start_date < #{endDate}) AS total_duration_min, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pos.battery_level), 0) FROM drives d LEFT JOIN positions pos ON d.start_position_id = pos.id WHERE d.car_id = #{carId} AND d.start_date >= #{startDate} AND d.start_date < #{endDate}) AS total_start_battery, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pos.battery_level), 0) FROM drives d LEFT JOIN positions pos ON d.end_position_id = pos.id WHERE d.car_id = #{carId} AND d.start_date >= #{startDate} AND d.start_date < #{endDate}) AS total_end_battery, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND start_date >= #{startDate} AND start_date < #{endDate}) AS charge_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charge_energy_added), 0) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND start_date >= #{startDate} AND start_date < #{endDate}) AS total_charge_energy
